boundaries: 12 non-arithmetic memory opcode families use one resumable handler in both owners.
STX/XTS keep store acceptance before address/stack effects and their second read.
The shared BRZ drains through the existing explicit FIFO MRAM policy; no synchronous flush bypass.
Privileged STI/ITS preserve their special-register selection and original ordering.
Instruction overlap, device DMA, automatic variable AU deadlines, raw AU input control and hardware OS acceptance remain unfinished.
